description: This file defines the object `VoiceWakeCommandExtractor`, which provides functionality to extract voice commands from input text based on trigger words. It includes a method to parse the input string, identify trigger words, and extract the command following the trigger. Additionally, it contains a helper extension function to identify punctuation characters.

classes.name: VoiceWakeCommandExtractor
classes.description: A singleton object providing voice command extraction utilities.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command from input text based on provided trigger words, returning the command string or null if none found.

methods.name: Char.isPunctuation
methods.description: Extension function to determine if a character is considered punctuation.
